note: What the library holds when the page opens. Written by tools/scan.js; run it after adding models. The packs themselves are not in the repository: re-download them from `downloads` below and run the tool again.

downloads.excluded: This is a modular kit, not a set of objects. 101 of its 153 models are facade parts - wall panels, columns, window sections, cornices, road markings, door frames, interior floor tiles - which mean nothing until assembled into a building. Assembling facades from panels is level design, which 00-plan.md lists as a risk to stop rather than tool for. The 52 that remain are objects: three buildings, five props, the streets, sidewalks, roofs, doors and stairs. The files are left on disk because they are 2 MB and the pack folder has to stay for the other 52; this is about what the library offers, not about space.

downloads.established: These 2017 downloads shipped with no licence file. quaternius.com/faq.html states "All models are under the CC0 License", checked 2026-08-03, and every other Quaternius pack here carries an explicit CC0 1.0 file. Established rather than assumed, so scan.js keeps it.
